scope: Current local source tree; source/publication inventory only, not production or independent audit approval.

method.english: Read scalar frontmatter fields from all src/content/guides/*.md; resolve content status and evaluate the imported publication policy.
method.chinese: Import zhGermanyA1Guides, verify each Astro route source exists, resolve content status and evaluate the imported publication policy.
method.deduplicationKey: routePath (locale-specific canonical route); count each English or Chinese page once. The 17 retained paths are already included in the 53 EN + 8 ZH denominator.
method.recommendations: maintain for existing pillars; task-review for pending and retained pages. Recommendations authorize neither indexing expansion, source-status promotion, merge nor deletion.
method.wordCounts: English diagnostic only; same URL/tag removal and Unicode word matcher as tests/scheme-3-english-content-quality.test.mjs. No word-count eligibility claim; Chinese not counted by this English diagnostic.
